[Benzinga news, 2026-10-23T13:32:48Z, by staff] Alpha Metallurgical Resources Announces Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
Alpha Metallurgical Resources reported preliminary financial results for the third quarter of 2026, including an expected net loss of $9.3 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $29.4 million.
Alpha Metallurgical Resources, Inc. announced preliminary financial results for the third quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company expects to report a net loss of $9.3 million, or $0.73 per diluted share, with total Adjusted EBITDA projected at $29.4 million. As of September 30, 2026, the company maintained total liquidity of $443.4 million, consisting of $334.1 million in cash and cash equivalents and $184.3 million in unused availability under its asset-based revolving credit facility. CEO Andy Eidson noted that while volumes were stronger than in the first half of the year, the results were impacted by continued cost pressures and market volatility. The company is scheduled to release its definitive third quarter financial results on November 6, 2026.

memos_so_far.headline: Preliminary Q3 loss for a coal miner, no consensus to compare; AMR -1.8%
reasoning: Primary source: Alpha's release on PR Newswire (first on Benzinga 12:07 UTC, 08:07 ET). Quoted: 'an expected net loss of $9.3 million, or $0.73 per diluted share, with total Adjusted EBITDA projected at $29.4 million'; 'total liquidity of $443.4 million'; the CEO 'noted that while volumes were stronger than in the first half of the year, the results were impacted by continued cost pressures and market volatility'.
What changed: a small loss with adequate liquidity; no guidance change and no consensus figure in our sources, so no measurable surprise. Final results Nov 6.
Price: AMR 157.08 vs 160.00, -1.8%, on 1,150 IEX shares.
objections: No consensus to measure a surprise; small move; thin on IEX.
